sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$1,000.
Glide starts Thu 3:00am CT: limit slides from -$1,000 to $0 by Thu 7:00am CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Thu 5:30am CT.
Even-up from Thu 6:00am CT, last-resort take from Thu 6:40am CT, green flag Thu 7:00am CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
